summary: The cut is clean and the camera orbit reads smoothly, but he drops from standing to a deep squat in about 0.17 s with no anticipation, and his feet are cropped at the bottom edge of the early frames.

faults.what: From 53.66 to 53.83 he goes from upright with arms out to a deep wide squat with arms tucked in. There is no anticipation, and the hips drop and the arms fold almost at once. It reads as a pose snap, not a weighted dip. It also begins in the first frames of the shot, so it could be read as the cut settling.
faults.fix: Add 2-3 frames of anticipation (a small rise or lean) before the drop, or start the shot already in the squat. Ease the arm fold so it follows the hips.

faults.what: His feet sit at or below the bottom edge in tiles 53.66-53.76, so the planted feet are cropped while he is standing. The feet only come into view as he squats.
faults.fix: Raise the camera or tilt it down slightly, or pull back a little, so the feet stay in frame during the orbit.
